scope: Remux preservation for the supported single-video Matroska paths; synthetic independently authored container contents. Not P5 reconstruction or creative-grade acceptance.
independent_expectations: PCM waveform samples authored in Python
Binary attachment with explicit expected SHA-256
Two chapters with explicit UIDs and titles
French Canadian video language, name, flags, display size and stereo value
Extracted original base-layer VCL NAL SHA-256; enhancement layer and RPU excluded by design
Extracted chapter XML and per-track timestamps before/after

unicode.cross_platform_fixture: Synthetic standard P7 authored on Linux then converted with Mac bundled tools
unicode.before_fix: NFC to NFD accent decomposition caused conservative remux refusal; source retained
unicode.after_fix: Canonical Unicode name comparison passed; Rust controls reject removed accents, changed case, whitespace and different names

negative_controls: Standard remux header loss rejects before source replacement
Hybrid remux header loss rejects even with --delete-sources; both sources retained and FAILED output available
limitations: Runtime guard verifies selected container headers, attachment metadata and chapter counts, not extracted payload hashes on every user conversion. Independent tests perform payload comparisons.
Synthetic regression uses PCM audio and SRT subtitles, not an exhaustive inventory of every Matroska codec or metadata extension.
Non-pixel display units and unsupported stereo metadata fail conservatively.
No hosted CI run, published release or Dolby-display QC.
